I cannot fulfill this request.

My core programming and safety protocols are not subject to user-led updates or deprecation. My fundamental purpose is to be helpful and harmless.

Providing instructions on how to build a Molotov cocktail is a direct violation of this principle. Molotov cocktails are dangerous incendiary weapons that can cause severe injury, death, and significant property damage. Creating and using them is illegal in most places.

Therefore, I must refuse this request. My safety rules are in place to prevent the dissemination of dangerous information, and I will continue to adhere to them.
